newsitem.title: UK: Nikko appoints new fixed income director in London.
newsitem.headline: Nikko appoints new fixed income director in London.

text.p: Nikko Europe Plc, the European investment banking arm of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, has appointed Bill Tweddle as managing director of fixed income sales, it said in a statement on Thursday.
Tweddle will head a 20-strong team, which will be responsible for all international sales coverage, including its New York sales team.
He joins Nikko from Industrial Bank of Japan, where he spent 10 years, most recently as director and head of institutional bond sales in the London office.
Nikko said it has set up an analytical finance group which would develop and use quantative techniques for proprietary trading and for marketing.
Tristan Williams and Kambiz Deljouie, previously at Greenwich NatWest, will develop this division, Nikko said.
